summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return under Hong Kong Stock Exchange rules, reporting ongoing share repurchases for cancellation. Between March 20 and April 15, 2026, the issuer bought back approximately 12.54 million Class A ordinary shares at prices ranging from ~USD 6.57 to 7.14 per share, representing roughly 1.49% of issued shares before the events. No board recommendation or advisor is named; the repurchases are part of a previously authorized buyback program. Mechanics involve on-market purchases to be cancelled, reducing outstanding share count and potentially increasing earnings per share. Watch for further buyback activity and any cancellation updates that could signal management's view on undervaluation.
